title: Caramel Peanut Sundae
changes_from_base: A home-churned vanilla custard ice cream with peanuts, a butter caramel and chocolate wafer pieces replace the bought ice cream and hot fudge.
summary: An impressive layered sundae combining silky homemade vanilla ice cream with salted peanuts, crispy wafers and a smooth caramel sauce. Pure indulgence.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
vanilla pod, split and seeds scraped
square chocolate-coated wafer bars, each cut into quarters
double cream, whipped to soft peaks

steps.title: Caramel
steps.text: Melt 100 g caster sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring often. On low heat, carefully add 30 g butter, 60 ml double cream and 60 ml whole milk. Off the heat, stir in ¼ tsp flaky sea salt and 2 tbsp light corn syrup or glucose syrup, then cool and chill for at least 2 h or overnight.

steps.title: Custard
steps.text: Heat 360 ml whole milk with the split vanilla pod and scraped seeds and 1 tbsp glucose syrup until steaming. Whisk 4 large egg yolks and 65 g caster sugar until pale.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Whisk in a third of the hot milk to the egg mixture, then return to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until it coats the back of a spoon at 77-80 °C.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Strain the custard into a bowl over iced water and cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn in the ice-cream maker until thick, stir in 70 g chopped salted peanuts and freeze in a container until firm.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Cut the 3 chocolate-coated wafer bars into quarters (12 pieces total).

steps.title: Build
steps.text: In a tall glass, alternate layers of caramel, a wafer quarter and scoops of the peanut ice cream.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Finish with more caramel, 140 g coarsely chopped salted peanuts and whipped cream.

tips: Chill the caramel for at least 2 h, or overnight, so it thickens to a pourable sauce.
Cook the custard carefully to exactly 77-80 °C for a silky, safe ice cream.
Chill the peanut ice cream until firm before assembling the sundae.
storage: Keep the caramel covered in the fridge and the peanut ice cream in a sealed container in the freezer; assemble the sundaes just before serving.
